description.value: Cedar Wood Lodge is Alberni Valley's self-described only four-star accommodation, offering 8 guestroom suites with private en-suite spa tubs, gas fireplaces, and air conditioning, run by hosts Tom and Marla Housholder who relocated from Utah in 2004 to build the property. Situated on BC Highway 4 in Port Alberni, it serves as a comfortable base for exploring the Alberni Inlet, Harbour Quay, and area trails, with a full continental breakfast buffet and packed lunches available on request. Conference and catering facilities round out a property that blends leisure hospitality with practical amenities.

address.value: 5895 River Road (BC Hwy 4), Port Alberni, BC V9Y 6Z5

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at cedarwood.bc.ca is fully accessible and provides extensive detail: Wi-Fi is explicitly confirmed ('FREE WIFI', 'High-Speed Wireless Internet'), a packed lunch is available on request, and nearby restaurants are cited. However, no page mentions bike storage, cycling-specific services, laundry, or e-bike charging, leaving both required criteria as null. The FAQ page provides explicit negative evidence on wheelchair accessibility and pets, and the copyright year of 2026 confirms the business is currently operating.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number; phone (250) 724-6800 sourced exclusively from website — contact_confirmed.phone set to null.

Website homepage uses the variant name 'Cedarwood Lodge Bed & Breakfast Inn' (one word, with 'Inn') while the OSM record and all site footer instances use 'Cedar Wood Lodge Bed & Breakfast'; minor name inconsistency.
No mention of bike storage, bike handling procedures, e-bike charging, or any cycling-specific facilities anywhere across the fetched website pages.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, currently operating four-star B&B on Vancouver Island that would appeal to touring cyclists, but neither required criterion (secure bike storage, staff bike procedure knowledge) can be confirmed from the website. Direct contact with the property is needed before a confident include decision.
enrichment_extras.notes: Property is adult-only (guests under 16 not currently accepted). FAQ explicitly states guest rooms are NOT wheelchair accessible. Pets not permitted (service/disability assistance dogs excepted). Non-smoking facility with a designated outdoor smoking area.

Early or packed breakfast.detail: Website states: 'On request, for a nominal fee, we will prepare a hearty Fisherman's packed lunch to take with you on your daily adventures.'
